selection_rationale: Openly licensed, text-native technical standards from NIST sharing common RMF core functions (GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, MANAGE) across two publications/years (2023 base framework vs. 2024 GenAI profile), ideal for comparing fixed-size vs. paragraph/section-aware chunking and metadata filtering.
page_counting_rule: Count physical PDF pages containing substantive body or appendix text extracted cleanly by pypdf. Exclude covers, title/notice front matter, Table of Contents, List of Figures, back covers, and reference-only pages (Appendix B References in NIST AI 600-1).
